origin.description: Wrap an object that already knows its width, and return it as one pillar component.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object with width and min_width attributes, such as a pillar title or a pillar type.

origin.details: The helper is new_pillar_component(list(x), width = the object's width, min_width = the object's minimum width). A title "letters" is 7 columns wide and its minimum is 7, because that is under the default of 20. The type of letters is chr. The styled label <chr> is 5 columns, so the component's width and minimum width are both 5. The type does not depend on the 26 letters.

translation.description: The same wrap. The title and the type are the objects from this package.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A pillar_title or a pillar_type. The width and minimum width are copied. If minimum width was never set, the width is used.

translation.details: letters is the 26 strings from a through z, passed as a list. new_pillar_title("letters") has width 7 and minimum width 7. new_pillar_type of those letters has width 5 and minimum width 5. The component holds that object as the single list element and repeats the two widths.
translation.example:
import string

from cli._options import options as cli_options

cli_options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8, "cli.unicode": True})

from pillar.parts import new_pillar_title, new_pillar_type, pillar_component

print(pillar_component(new_pillar_title("letters")))
print(pillar_component(new_pillar_type(list(string.ascii_lowercase))))
